mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day returns: lower rates compress discount rates and boost equity valuations, leading to positive returns when rates are at historically low levels (0.15% in the snapshot).
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weakening labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt a more accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0% (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 growth > 3% annualized and UNRATE < 4.0%), a rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3% annualized and UNRATE < 4.0%) AND UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 900 thousand units signals a robust housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and leads to positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above 900.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 99.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 900 thousand units signals a robust housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and leads to positive S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above 900.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 5-day returns: lower rates compress discount rates and boost equity valuations, leading to positive returns when rates are at historically low levels (0.15% in the snapshot).
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (over the last 5 years).
